Query-gap parity vectors yield an upper VC obstruction at t>=r+2, with all-positive labeling bounding t<=k; the explicit even-coordinate support and closing-segment completion attain min(k,r+1). A marked-vertex composition count gives |I|=n/(n-k)*binom(n-k,k). Concatenated r threshold blocks realize sum floor(log2(b_i+1)) online mistakes, and class count upper-bounds Ldim, proving r log2 k+O_r(1) for fixed r>=1. The analogous path count and r+1 threshold blocks give its (r+1)log2 k+O_r(1), while same VC. Independent brute enumeration checked cycle VC for all 26 feasible (n,k) pairs with 3<=n<=9 and exact recursive finite Ldim within sharp stated bounds, including r=0 and k=0 boundaries.
